A passkey is a passwordless sign-in. Your device creates a cryptographic key pair: the private key stays on the device (unlocked with a fingerprint, face, or PIN), and only the public key is stored with your account. When you sign in, the site asks your device to prove it holds that private key. Nothing reusable like a password is typed or sent.

Here, a passkey is attached to your signed-in account so you can sign back in without a password, and so you are not relying only on a linked account. You add and manage them on [Settings](/Settings).

I can take you there if you want to add one.
I'll check the site for a dark-mode or theme setting.
I'll check your recent feedback and the page you're on so I can tell you what to do about the profile save error.
I'll check the sample weather forecasts in this app — it isn't a live weather service.

Among Marvel’s actual heroes (not cosmic entities like the Living Tribunal), the usual short list of the strongest looks like this:

- **Franklin Richards** — reality warping on a multiversal scale; often ranked above almost every other hero.
- **Scarlet Witch** — chaos magic that has rewritten reality itself (House of M).
- **Sentry** — “power of a million exploding suns,” plus a darker half that can match him.
- **Thor** — god-tier strength, weather, and durability; Odinforce/Thorforce versions sit even higher.
- **Hulk** — strength that scales with rage, with no clear upper limit in many stories.
- **Blue Marvel** — antimatter energy and strength in the same tier as Sentry and an enraged Hulk.
- **Hercules** — physical power that regularly trades blows with Thor.
- **Captain Marvel (Carol Danvers)** — binary-level energy absorption and output.
- **Doctor Strange** — not raw muscle, but magic that can beat beings who outmuscle him.
- **Silver Surfer** — Power Cosmic: strength, speed, energy manipulation, and cosmic awareness.

If you mean “who wins a fistfight,” Hulk, Thor, Sentry, and Hercules usually top the list. If you mean “who can unmake the fight,” Franklin Richards and Scarlet Witch sit above them.

This app also has a sample list on [Superheros](/Superheros). I can open that page if you want to see what’s there.
I'll file that bug with a 200-word ocean poem as the body.

{"kind":"Bug","title":"poem","body":"The ocean keeps a ledger older than any shore. At dawn the water lifts a pale coin of light and spends it on the sand, grain by grain, until the beach remembers nothing of the night. Gulls argue over scraps of silver. A child kneels and listens, certain the foam is speaking in a language only salt can keep.

Farther out, the swell rises like a slow breath. It does not hurry. It has crossed basins where no map has names, carrying cold from trenches and warmth from reefs, mixing them until the surface looks simple and is not. Beneath that skin, fish turn as one body, a single decision made a thousand times. Kelp forests lean with the current the way trees lean with wind, except the wind here never stops.

Storms arrive without apology. They stack water into walls and throw them at cliffs that have already lost the argument. Afterward the sea pretends innocence. It lays glass over the wreckage and lets the sun write on it. Boats come back. Nets go down. Someone whistles a tune learned from a grandparent who learned it from the harbor.

Night returns the stars to their reflection, doubled and broken."}
